Usage: claude [options] [command] [prompt]

Options:
  -p, --print  Noninteractive output

Commands:
  agents [options]             Background sessions
  attach <id>                  Attach
  auth                         Authentication
  auto-mode                    Inspect configuration
  doctor                       Diagnostics
  gateway [options]            Gateway
  import [source]              Import
  install [target]             Install
  logs <id>                    Logs
  mcp                          MCP configuration
  plugin|plugins               Plugins
  project                      Project state
  respawn <id>                 Restart
  rm <id>                      Remove
  setup-token                  Authentication
  stop|kill <id>               Stop
  ultrareview [target]          Review
  update|upgrade               Update
  future-headless|future-alias  Synthetic future command
                               Continuation text must not become a command.
